tasks.title: Verify the unified setup major-upgrade path from a supported previous release
evidence: src/OnlyWinget.Setup/OnlyWinget.Setup.wxs defines MajorUpgrade and a stable UpgradeCode for the internal MSIs.
src/OnlyWinget.Setup/OnlyWinget.Bundle.wxs defines a stable Bundle UpgradeCode for the unified setup.
tests/OnlyWinget.Tests/SourceAlignmentTests.cs checks for MajorUpgrade and same-version upgrade support in the MSI source.
scripts/build-msi.ps1 generates the current-version setup and internal MSIs from the repository sources, but it does not supply a supported previous release artifact to upgrade from.

The repository does not include an automated clean-host upgrade verification flow, a versioned previous release artifact in the workspace, or git tags that identify a packaged prior release to upgrade from.
tasks.impact: A real end-user upgrade from a supported previous release to the current unified setup remains unproven before release.
tasks.recommended_action: Run an upgrade from a supported previous installer artifact to the current setup on a clean or dedicated Windows host, then verify replacement, app launch, and final uninstall.
tasks.blocked_reason: This requires both a supported previous installer artifact and a clean or dedicated Windows host. The current repository workspace can generate the current installer set, but it does not automate or supply the end-to-end upgrade input.
acceptance_criteria: The supported previous version installs without errors on a supported Windows machine.
The current setup upgrades the existing installation successfully.
The application starts correctly after the upgrade.
The final uninstall completes without errors and removes the installed directory.
